name: LinkedSocialToolkit
headline: LinkedSocialToolkit - Automate LinkedIn Marketing
short_description: With Linked Social Toolkit [LST] you can like posts & comments, send birthday wishes, work anniversary wishes & new job wishes, send messages to connections, auto respond to messages, connect, remove, follow, view & endorse connections, withdraw & accept invitations, get connections information...
author: ZiaUrR3hman

sections.overview:
Linked Social Toolkit is a browser extension that automates LinkedIn prospecting and B2B lead generation workflows. It enables users to send personalized mass messages with attachments, automate connection requests with invitations, endorse skills, follow prospects, and gather connection profile data for analysis. The toolkit includes real-time auto-responder functionality for messages, birthday wishes, work anniversaries, and new job notifications. Built for startups, entrepreneurs, and online marketers, it reduces manual outreach time while helping users find leads, build credibility, and increase sales pipeline through targeted engagement across 1st, 2nd, and 3rd degree connections.
Send personalized bulk messages and birthday greetings to thousands of connections
Automate connection requests with custom invitations from targeted prospect lists
Set up real-time auto-responses to messages, endorsements, and life event greetings
Export connection profile data to spreadsheets for lead analysis and segmentation
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/ZiaUrR3hman/LinkedSocialToolkit`
sections.usage:
```
Using Linked Social Toolkit [LST], I want to automate the following tasks: [TASKS]. For each task, provide the specific steps and any necessary details such as [DETAILS]. Ensure the actions are scheduled for [TIMEFRAME].
```
Copy

```
To automate your LinkedIn activities using Linked Social Toolkit [LST], follow these steps:

1. **Liking Posts & Comments**: Schedule LST to like 10 posts per day from your network. Focus on posts related to [INDUSTRY] to increase visibility.
2. **Sending Birthday Wishes**: Set up automated birthday wishes for your connections. Personalize the message with a template like, 'Happy Birthday, [NAME]! Wishing you a fantastic day ahead.'
3. **Sending Work Anniversary Wishes**: Automate work anniversary messages. Use a template such as, 'Congratulations on your work anniversary, [NAME]! Wishing you continued success.'
4. **Sending New Job Wishes**: Schedule messages for connections who have new jobs. Example message: 'Congratulations on your new role at [COMPANY], [NAME]! Wishing you great success in your new position.'
5. **Sending Messages to Connections**: Automate messages to new connections. Use a template like, 'Hi [NAME], it was great connecting with you. Looking forward to staying in touch.'
6. **Auto Responding to Messages**: Set up auto-responses for common inquiries. Example: 'Thanks for reaching out, [NAME]. I will get back to you shortly with more details.'
7. **Connecting, Removing, Following, Viewing & Endorsing Connections**: Schedule LST to connect with 5 new people per day in your industry. Remove inactive connections and follow key influencers.
8. **Withdrawing & Accepting Invitations**: Automate the process of withdrawing pending invitations and accepting new ones.
9. **Getting Connections Information**: Schedule LST to gather information on your connections, such as job titles and companies, to stay updated.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
